The first Wrapped only saw about eleven hours of the week. The counter behind it hit its free limit on launch day and stopped recording, and I didn't catch it until now. A second count was running the whole time, so the numbers are rebuilt from both. It is at least 79,715 builds people shared, saved or opened, not 16,176 (some visitors block the second count, so the true number is higher), and the Wrapped and every class's Popular builds fold now show it. Popular builds also rank by build family now: builds within a few points of each other count together, so one much-clicked link can't outrank a build hundreds of people arrived at. Two honest notes: thirteen hours of launch day were caught by neither count and stay missing, and pick rates now count complete builds only, so a much-clicked link to a half-finished build can't pass as a pick.
The first beta client. Everything the site showed before this came from BlizzCon demo footage; this is what the client's own files changed.

The gold gift box in the top corner opens beta week in numbers: how many builds got made, which class built the most, the spec each class chose, the talent everyone takes and the one nobody does, and the most shared build per class drawn point by point. Six days, 16,176 builds, none of it about who you are. Recounted since with the days that were missed, see the newer entry.
